Start: Lead, Record Created, Before Save
Get Territory Rule:
  Territory_Assignment__c
  WHERE State__c = {!$Record.State}
Decision: Territory Match Found?
caption: Named per Lesson 27's convention; before-save chosen because this is only a field update.

code:
Matched:
  Assign Owner From Territory
  {!$Record.OwnerId} = territoryMatch.Owner

No Match:
  Assign Owner To Fallback Queue
  {!$Record.OwnerId} = UnassignedLeadsQueueId
caption: Every lead gets an owner — the matched account executive, or the fallback queue.
